name: genshin-mods
description: Six Claude Code mods: five under one band above the prompt, waypoints (the next steps, one press each), resin (cache, context, limits and cost, with warm, compact and a one-click handoff), veil (recording mode), commission (a goal's task list and clock) ward (a question before editing a file another session just changed), pulse (the machine watcher), and three guards: a delegation guard that nudges a run of lookups toward a haiku agent, a disk-scan guard that refuses a Bash scan from a root or home folder, and a whole-index guard that refuses a git command over the whole index while another session shares the checkout.
